alt: Each range update drawn as a bar over the array's index line, one row per range so overlapping ranges stay visible, building up to all ranges shown at once.

steps.caption: The first range runs from index 0 through index 2 and adds 3. Drawing it on row 0 keeps it clear of the rows above.
The second range runs from index 1 through index 4 and adds 2. Drawing it on row 1 keeps it clear of the rows above.
The third range runs from index 3 through index 3 and adds 1. Drawing it on row 2 keeps it clear of the rows above.
All 3 ranges sit on the line together now. Any index covered by more than one row picks up every one of those additions once diff is rebuilt.
